meta.metric: Years from a BCI modality's first pivotal preclinical animal demonstration to its first-in-human implant. Most entries are nonhuman-primate; the animal model is recorded per entry (Synchron's pivotal preclinical work was in sheep).

First pivotal preclinical animal-event dates and a consistent modality taxonomy are not established. Corrected source records are retained below, with their actual precision and basis; no latency series or direction is approved under the existing metric. This source-check date is not a new implant observation.
